fields.statement: QA cycle 1, built binary at 73540a2d in a scratch root with fake rex/claude shims: rhiza run start --foreground (owner-run) whose agent hook reported Notification permission_prompt 'Allow Bash: echo secret@example.com?' showed at once in rhiza inbox / --json as kind permission with run, step build, session, detail, tab, tab_block, tab_session and next 'rhiza inbox open <id>'; rhiza inbox open <id> focused the session's block (rex focus -s session:s1 block:b1); rhiza daemon --once --notify-command ran the hook once with kind permission JSON and RHIZA_INBOX_TITLE '...: a session waits on a permission prompt: Allow Bash: ...'; a newer rex idle report in the session record cleared it (Nothing waits on you); an --autonomous run listed the permission item too. Scoped tests inboxapp, api TestWebInbox, scripts inbox-permission/daemon-notify-hook/inbox-stalled/inbox-open pass.

QA cycle 1, built binary: rhiza session message <sid> 'Use blue' --timeout 3s to a session whose hook reported a permission prompt printed one stderr line 'waiting for session <sid>: blocked on a permission: Claude needs your permission to use Bash; answer it with rhiza inbox open (or rhiza session show <sid>); waiting up to 3s' and after 3.1s failed (exit 3) with 'did not reach its prompt within 3s (last status: blocked on a permission: ...)', next rhiza session show. Scoped api TestSessionMessage passes.

QA cycle 1, built binary: after a hook permission block, rhiza session run with a fake rex events stream reporting block:b1 idle 12s later made rhiza session show give 'Status: idle ... (from rex)' with the hook block kept underneath, and rhiza session message then delivered at once (Waited 0s): exactly one rex send of the pointer and one send-key enter. Scoped internal/session tests and session-message-permission.txtar pass.
